risks.title: Dependence on external financing
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the 10-K, repeated mention of materially and adversely negative impact if financing is not available. Strong language: 'materially and adversely impacted'. Structural dependence on external capital for growth. Capital category heavily weighted.

risks.title: 2B$ purchase commitments
risks.score_rationale: Major commitment of 2 billion dollars in solar equipment through end of 2025. Although terminable without penalty, this exposes the company to logistics and market risks. Explicit mention in operational risks. Industrial category with medium weighting.

risks.title: Sensitivity to economic conditions
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly cited related to economic uncertainties affecting markets. Impact on ability to raise capital and on demand. Assertive language: 'adversely impact'. Macro category important in context of volatility.

risks.title: Exposure to variable interest rates
risks.score_rationale: Presented in Item 7A, exposure to SOFR rates. A 10% increase would cost 11.3M$ in 2025. Quantified but contained risk through partial hedging. Credit category with moderate weighting.

risks.title: Complexity of tax equity funds
risks.score_rationale: Presence of 1B$ in noncontrolling interests and 0.7B$ in redeemable interests. HLBV method is complex, highlighted as 'critical audit matter'. Major operational and accounting risk. Industrial category reinforced by structural complexity.

ai_positioning.summary: RUN does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
